a1_explicit_any.description: Frontend lines (not tests or components/ui) that type something as `any`.

b1_pure_module_purity.description: frappe.db/get_all/get_doc/sql usages inside declared PURE_MODULES (a pure module must have none).

b2_predicate_literal_scatter.description: Files hardcoding the "Vendor Selected" state literal instead of importing the shared predicate.

b3_workflow_state_writers.description: Lines that assign workflow_state in api/ + integrations/ (state should be derived, not written ad-hoc).

f2_inline_json_parse_pages.description: Inline JSON.parse occurrences in pages/ (backend shapes should be parsed at one typed accessor).

f5_raw_updatedoc_files.description: Frontend files calling useFrappeUpdateDoc / updateDoc( directly instead of one write-safety seam.

p1_payment_sum_copies.description: Lines that add up Project Payments amounts (frontend, backend, print formats) outside the allowed owners in PAYMENT_SUM_OWNERS: the Amount Paid rule, the payment caps, the bank cash-out lists.

p1_tds_added_to_amount_paid.description: Lines adding a Work Order's total_tds (or a deduction's tds_amount) onto amount_paid outside PAYMENT_SUM_OWNERS: amount_paid already holds the TDS withheld from the vendor, so the sum counts it twice.

r1_rupee_formatters.description: Functions that format rupees outside RUPEE_FORMATTER_HOMES.

s1_oversized_files.description: Hand-written source files (not tests, patches or components/ui) over 500 lines.

t1_tests_pick_any_row.description: Lines in test_*.py fetching a row with empty filters (get_value(doctype, {}...)): the record depends on whatever was modified last.
